description: This file defines a ViewModel named SharedRecipeViewModel for managing recipe data in an Android application. It interacts with a RecipeRepositorySqlite to load, save, update, delete, and toggle favorite status of recipes, exposing data via LiveData for UI components.

classes.name: SharedRecipeViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel that provides recipe data and operations for recipe detail and editing screens, handling data loading, modification, deletion, and toggling favorite status.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a recipe by its ID from the repository and updates LiveData.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of the current recipe and updates the repository.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Creates a new recipe or updates an existing recipe in the repository.

methods.name: deleteCurrent
methods.description: Deletes the currently selected recipe from the repository.
